generator_cmd: perl -CSA -e 'my ($cov, $p, $w) = @ARGV; my $t = join q(), map { chr(0xE0000 + ord) } split //, $p; $t = chr(0xE0001) . $t . chr(0xE007F) if $w; print $cov . $t' "$cover" "$plain" "$wrap"
oracle_cmd: python3 -I -c "import sys; print(''.join(chr(ord(c) - 0xE0000) for c in sys.argv[1] if 0xE0020 <= ord(c) <= 0xE007E), end='')" "$encoded"
